en.name: JSON Array Generator
en.description: Generate a sample JSON array in your browser. Set the number of objects and the field names, and get a pretty-printed JSON array of example objects you can copy, download, or use as test data.

meta.title: JSON Array Generator – Generate a JSON Array Example Online
meta.description: Generate a JSON array online. Set the item count and field names to create a sample JSON array of example objects. Copy or download the result in your browser.

features.title: Set the Item Count
features.description: Choose how many objects the array should contain. The generator creates exactly that many items, numbered from the first element.

features.title: Define Field Names
features.description: Type a comma-separated list of field names. Each object in the array uses those keys, so the result matches the shape you need.

features.title: Smart Sample Values
features.description: Field types are inferred from the name: id gets a number, email gets an address, age gets a number, and so on. Add an explicit type with field:type (such as age:int:18-65, active:bool, price:float, status:enum:active|inactive, tags:array) to force a type, and use dotted names like address.city to build nested objects.

features.title: Pretty-Printed Output
features.description: The result is a formatted JSON array you can read immediately. Copy it or download it as a .json file.

features.title: Copy or Download
features.description: Copy the generated array to your clipboard or download it as a .json file for use as fixtures, mocks, or API examples.

features.title: Browser-Based Processing
features.description: Generation happens in your browser. The page does not require an account or send your input to a remote service.

ui.hint_fields: Optional types: field:type or field:type:rule. e.g. age:int:18-65, active:bool, price:float, status:enum:active|inactive, tags:array, address.city (nesting).
ui.placeholder_output: The generated array will appear here...
ui.error_empty_fields: Enter at least one field name
ui.error_invalid_count: Enter a number greater than zero
ui.error_processing: The array could not be generated

guide.title: Set the item count
guide.description: Enter how many objects you want in the array. The count must be a positive number.

guide.title: List the field names
guide.description: Type the field names separated by commas, for example id, name, email. Add a type with field:type to force a value type (age:int:18-65, active:bool, price:float, status:enum:active|inactive, tags:array), and use dotted names like address.city to nest objects.

guide.title: Generate the array
guide.description: Click Generate JSON Array. The tool builds a pretty-printed JSON array of example objects.

guide.title: Copy or download
guide.description: Copy the array or download it as a .json file. Use it as test data, a mock response, or a documentation example.

example.title: JSON Array Generator Example
example.description: Create a small array of example user objects with typed and nested fields.
example.input:
Count: 2
Fields: id, name, email, age:int:18-40, active:bool, address.city
example.inputExplanation: Two objects with inferred fields plus a typed age, a boolean flag, and a nested address.city key.
example.outputExplanation: id increments per item, age is a random integer in the 18-40 range, active is a boolean, and address.city is nested into an object automatically.
example.note: Sample values are placeholders for testing, not real records.

faq.question: What does the JSON array generator do?
faq.answer: It builds a JSON array of example objects. You set the number of objects and the field names, and the tool produces a pretty-printed JSON array you can copy or download.

faq.question: What sample values does it create?
faq.answer: Types are inferred from field names: id gets an incrementing number, email gets an address such as user1@example.com, age or price get numbers, and other fields get labeled sample text. You can override any field with an explicit type, for example age:int:18-65 or active:bool, and use dotted names like address.city to build nested objects.

faq.question: Can I generate an empty or zero-length array?
faq.answer: The count must be a positive number, so the smallest array has one object. This keeps the generated example useful as test data.

faq.question: Can I choose the value types?
faq.answer: Yes. Append a type to a field with a colon, for example age:int:18-65, active:bool, price:float, createdAt:date, id:uuid, website:url, or tags:array. For an enum use status:enum:active|inactive|pending. Dotted names like address.city create nested objects automatically.

faq.question: Is the generated data real?
faq.answer: No. The values are placeholders for testing and documentation. Do not treat them as real people or records, and replace them before using the data in production.

faq.question: Is this a free JSON array generator?
faq.answer: Yes. You can generate a JSON array, copy it, or download it as a .json file without creating an account.

article.title: How to Generate a JSON Array Online
article.content:
What Is a JSON Array Generator?

A JSON array maker, also called a JSON array generator, lets you create json array content without writing it by hand. It builds a JSON array of objects from a few settings: set the item count and the field names and get a ready-to-use array.

How to Generate a JSON Array

  1. Set the count: choose how many objects the array should contain.
  2. List the fields: type the field names separated by commas.
  3. Generate: the tool creates a pretty-printed JSON array.
  4. Copy or download: use the result as fixtures, mocks, or examples.

Where It Helps

  • Test data: seed unit tests or API stubs with sample arrays.
  • Mock responses: return a realistic array from a local mock server.
  • Documentation: show a clear JSON array example in guides.
  • Prototyping: quickly shape the data a form or component expects.

Sample Values

Fields named like id receive incrementing numbers and email-style fields receive example addresses. Other fields get labeled sample text. The values are placeholders, so replace them with real data before any production use.

Privacy

Generation runs entirely in your browser. Your settings are not uploaded and no account is required.

faq.question: JSON 数组生成器是做什么的？
faq.answer: 它构建一组示例 JSON 对象组成的数组。你设置对象数量和字段名，工具就会生成一个美化输出的 JSON 数组，供你复制或下载。

faq.question: 它会生成什么样的示例值？
faq.answer: 类型由字段名推断：id 得到递增数字，email 得到示例地址（如 user1@example.com），age 或 price 得到数字，其他字段得到带标签的示例文本。你可以用显式类型覆盖任意字段，例如 age:int:18-65 或 active:bool，并用 address.city 这类带点的字段名来生成嵌套对象。

faq.question: 可以生成空数组或零长度数组吗？
faq.answer: 数量必须是正数，因此最小的数组也有一个对象。这样生成的示例才能作为有用的测试数据。

faq.question: 可以选择值的类型吗？
faq.answer: 可以。在字段后用冒号指定类型，例如 age:int:18-65、active:bool、price:float、createdAt:date、id:uuid、website:url，或 tags:array。枚举用 status:enum:active|inactive|pending。address.city 这类带点的字段名会自动生成嵌套对象。

faq.question: 生成的数据是真的吗？
faq.answer: 不是。这些值只是用于测试和文档的占位符。不要把它们当作真实的人或记录，投入生产前请替换成真实数据。

faq.question: 这是免费的 JSON 数组生成器吗？
faq.answer: 是。你可以生成 JSON 数组、复制它或下载成 .json 文件，且不需要注册账号。

article.title: 如何在线生成 JSON 数组
article.content:
什么是 JSON 数组生成器？

JSON 数组生成器（也叫 json 数组例子生成器）可以让你无需手写就创建 json 数组。它根据几个设置构建一组示例 JSON 对象组成的数组：设置对象数量和字段名，就能得到一份可直接使用的数组。

如何生成 JSON 数组

  1. 设置数量：选择数组要包含多少个对象。
  2. 列出字段：用逗号分隔输入字段名。
  3. 生成：工具会创建一个美化输出的 JSON 数组。
  4. 复制或下载：把结果用作测试数据、mock 或示例。

适用场景

  • 测试数据：用示例数组为单元测试或 API 桩提供数据。
  • mock 响应：在本地 mock 服务里返回逼真的数组。
  • 文档：在指南里展示清晰的 JSON 数组示例。
  • 原型：快速搭出表单或组件所期望的数据形状。

示例值

名称类似 id 的字段会得到递增数字，email 类字段会得到示例地址，其他字段会得到带标签的示例文本。这些值都是占位符，投入生产前请替换成真实数据。

隐私

生成完全在你的浏览器中运行，你的设置不会被上传，也不需要账号。
